_comment: Hand corrections merged over scraped creatures by build_packs.py, keyed by creature id. Each entry needs a 'why' so the next reader can tell a fix from an opinion.

alflingFastHero1CharismaticHero1.why: The mirror's own markup drops the H: the column is headed <th>alfling Fast Hero 1/Charismatic Hero 1</th> beside the halfling it is a build of. See https://spellbooksoftware.com/d20mrsd/urbanmonst2.html
alflingFastHero1CharismaticHero1.name: Halfling Fast Hero 1/Charismatic Hero 1

lizard.why: Urban Arcana prints no size-and-type line for the lizard: the row every other stat block heads with one is blank, and the book's own A-Z index gives no type either. Animal is what the entry itself describes - Intelligence 2, no allegiance, the d8 Hit Die it is written with, and species traits of low-light vision and a climb bonus. See https://spellbooksoftware.com/d20mrsd/urbanmonst2.html
